bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/ (path, raster, surface, context, color, image, paint, reusable_layer, pdf), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (Surface, Image), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_*.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (kit::cg re-export), springboard/ui/src/print.rs
summary: The render crate's cg tree is public to apps as bifrost_app::kit::cg, and the SDK adds graphics_context, graphics_stroke, graphics_gradient, graphics_color, graphics_imageio and graphics_pdf wrappers. Paths, stroking, lines, ellipses and arcs, clipping, transforms, colour ramps, shadings, patterns, CgImage, PNG and JPEG decode and encode, and PDF read and write exist as models. Apps reach only part of it (freeform gradients, Preview PDF read, draw and write); there is no full bitmap context that apps can use for PDF pages, and no display or window services.

features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. The context keeps a graphics state stack with CTM, clip, paints, alpha, blend mode, shadow, line parameters and interpolation quality, and draws into a premultiplied buffer. Preview and Freeform draw through the Surface and kit::cg; the graphics_context wrapper has no app caller yet. No page context for PDF output.

features.apple: CGPath, CGMutablePath, move/add/close, fill and stroke path
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/path.rs (Path, copy_by_stroking, copy_by_dashing), springboard/render/src/cg/raster.rs (scan conversion, StrokeStyle, FillRule), springboard/render/src/cg/surface.rs (fill_path, stroke_path), springboard/sdk/src/graphics_stroke.rs (stroke_outline, dash_polylines)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Path construction covers move, line, quadratic and cubic curves, arcs, rectangles and ellipses, with bounds, contains and transforms. Stroking supports caps, joins, miter limit and dashes. Boolean path operations are not done.

features.feature: Primitive shapes (rects, rounded rects, lines, ellipses, arcs)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/surface.rs (stroke_line, fill_ellipse, stroke_ellipse, stroke_arc, fill_arc), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (fill_rect, fill_rrect, stroke_rrect); springboard/sdk/src/graphics_context.rs (stroke_line, stroke_arc)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Lines, ellipses and arcs draw on the Surface through the scan converter, with line caps for lines and arcs. The SDK context strokes one line segment and one arc with its stroke colour and line width, tested headless in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-02.rs. Gap: no app calls the new line and arc wrappers yet; verify on Midget.

features.apple: CGContextClip, clip rect and clip path, CGContextClipToRect
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/context.rs (clip_to_rect, clip_to_rects, clip_to_path, clip_to_mask, reset_clip), springboard/render/src/cg/raster.rs (Coverage::clipped_by); springboard/sdk/src/graphics_context.rs, graphics_stroke.rs, graphics_gradient.rs
features.note: The clip model (Wave 3, theme-19) is gone, so no code implements this row. The Surface has no clip. Scroll views redraw the whole window in some cases to avoid clipping. clip_to_rect, clip (non-zero) and clip_with (even-odd) intersect an anti-aliased coverage mask that save_gstate and restore_gstate restore. Host tests only; verify on Midget.

features.feature: Affine transforms and transform stack (CGAffineTransform, CTM)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/path.rs (Affine), springboard/render/src/cg/context.rs (ctm, concat_ctm, translate_ctm, scale_ctm, rotate_ctm, point_to_device, rect_to_user)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. The context has a CTM stack with point, size and rect conversion between user and device space. The compositor still applies its own transforms to window surfaces.

features.apple: CGColor, CGColorSpace (sRGB, Display P3, generic gray and so on), CGColorConversionInfo
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/color.rs (Color, ColorSpace), springboard/render/src/icc.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_color.rs (space_from_profile, convert, conversion, is_wide_gamut)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Colour spaces and colours are modelled, with ICC profile loading and conversion through the SDK wrapper. The packed 8-bit pixels of the Surface remain sRGB; wide-gamut output is not drawn.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/paint.rs (ColorRamp, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, ConicGradient), springboard/render/src/gradient.rs, springboard/sdk/src/graphics_gradient.rs (Affine)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Linear, radial and conic gradients with extend flags, evaluated per pixel. Freeform-desktop uses ColorRamp and LinearGradient through kit::cg. The browser tile painter still has its own gradient code.

Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Sampled, exponential and stitching functions, and axial and radial shadings, evaluated per point. The Function type has no callback form. No app draws a shading yet.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/paint.rs (Pattern, Tiling, PatternPaint, invert_matrix); springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pattern.rs (CgPattern, PatternTiling)
features.note: The SDK CgPattern wraps the cell model: it samples the cell in user space with the pattern matrix, repeats it every step, and fits the step to device pixels for each tiling mode; headless tests are in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-02.rs. Gap: no pattern fill is connected to the Surface or to a context's fill call, and coloured-cell callbacks and uncoloured tinting are not in the SDK; verify the fill on Midget.

features.feature: Images and bitmaps (CGImage, image masks, cropping)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/cg/image.rs (CgImage, DataProvider, cropped, with_mask, with_masking_colors, to_premultiplied), springboard/render/src/gfx.rs (Image, blit)
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. CgImage carries bit depth, colour space, alpha info, byte order and a data provider. It supports 8 and 16-bit RGBA, cropping, masks and masking colours, and conversion to premultiplied pixels. HDR and CMYK are not drawn.

features.feature: Image file decoding and encoding (ImageIO-style, CGImageSource and CGImageDestination)
features.apple: CGImageSource and CGImageDestination (ImageIO, CGImage creation from files and data)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_imageio.rs (detect, pixel_size, decode, encode, encode_jpeg), springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Format detection, size probe, decode and encode through the SDK wrapper. Encoding covers the formats that can_write allows; WebP is refused. Only Shell apps use imgdec today.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/font.rs, springboard/render/src/cff.rs:137 Cff and :225 outline, springboard/render/src/gvar.rs, springboard/render/src/fontprefs.rs (font selection)
features.note: The font engine parses CFF and variable outlines and draws text through the UI text path. Apps get text drawing through the UI kit, not through a glyph-level CGFont API, and no font loading from data is exposed.

Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. Apps can open a PDF, read the page count and page size, and render a page to an image. Preview reads pages through kit::cg::pdf. Vector drawing from the reader is reached through draw.rs, not through a public document type.

features.feature: PDF creation and printing (CGPDFContext, print to PDF)
features.apple: CGPDFContextCreate, CGPDFContextBeginPage, print operations to PDF
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/graphics_pdf.rs (PdfWriter, PdfPage), springboard/render/src/cg/pdf/writer.rs (write, save, Annotation, Edits), springboard/ui/src/print.rs, springboard/apps/preview-desktop/src/export.rs
features.note: Team-k (parity/team-k-quartz) refresh: built on parity/team-k-quartz; not yet verified on Midget. PdfWriter builds new files from pages with filled and stroked rectangles, lines and raster images. Preview saves edited PDFs with annotations through writer::save. No pagination and no print-to-PDF filter pipeline; the print sheet's Save as PDF still copies the file.

CgLayer is the app-facing reusable layer: it keeps offscreen pixels and a draw count, is drawn into by a closure over a context, and is composited into any context with draw_layer_at (clip, alpha and blend apply); headless tests are in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-02.rs. Gap: no shell or app draws through a CgLayer yet; verify on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/display_info.rs (DisplayInfo, DisplayMode, main_display, at_point, diff); springboard/sdk/src/displays.rs (list, info, modes, reconfigured); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (presenter, outputs)
features.note: Apps read the display list, bounds, pixel size, modes and reconfiguration changes, tested headless in parity_sdk-os-01. Gap: the mode switch and its keep or revert step run in the shell, and live reconfiguration is not verified on the lab machine.

Window records, stacking-order scopes, desktop-element filtering, levels, title redaction and the wire form are tested in ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-19.rs. The SDK re-exports the model and the shell fills records from its window state; a live window list has not been checked on Midget.

features.feature: Event services (Quartz Event Services, CGEventTap, synthetic events)
features.apple: CGEvent, CGEventTapCreate, CGEventPost, mouse and keyboard event sources
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 18 tests. Wave 5 (w5-core-graphics, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Keyboard shortcuts are parsed inside the UI kit. Apps have no event tap or event posting API, and the agent input path is a separate tool, not an app API.

features.feature: Geometry data types (CGPoint, CGSize, CGRect, CGVector)
features.note: The UI kit has point, size and rect types for layout and hit testing. There is no CGVector equivalent.

gaps: No pagination or drawing context for PDF pages; the SDK PdfWriter emits rectangles, lines and images only, with no text or paths.
Most of the cg tree is not used by apps yet: the graphics_* SDK wrappers, shadings, patterns and CgImage have no app caller.
No pattern fill for paths or rectangles, and no shading draw call on the Surface.
No Boolean path operations (union, intersection, subtract).
Wide-gamut and ICC output: the Surface stays 8-bit sRGB; no HDR, CMYK or 16-bit drawing.
Image formats: decode and encode cover PNG and JPEG; no other containers in the SDK.
Display and window services: no SDK display list, mode or bounds API, and no window list for apps.
Event services: no event tap or synthetic event API for apps (not changed in this refresh).
docs/bifrost-ui.md has no Core Graphics mapping table, so the names above are not mapped to our APIs in the docs.
